answer: An hostile operator hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The zenith counter is kept in violet and raven shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 4 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
